sharedComponents.description: Only modified by current specification. No overlap with other specifications.
sharedComponents.recommendation: No action required - component is isolated to this specification

potentialInteractions.description: Both specifications modify code in repos/metabob-opencode that gets deployed to devbob containers. devbob-k8s-git-operations requires gh CLI in containers, while devbob-acp-multi-vessel-coordination requires updated OpenCode code (vessel/bootstrap.ts, acp-delegate.ts, acp/agent.ts)
potentialInteractions.impact: If container image is not rebuilt and redeployed, neither specification's changes will be active

resolution.action: Rebuild devbob container image with all changes
steps: Ensure Dockerfile.devbob-local includes gh CLI installation (already in place)
Ensure repos/metabob-opencode submodule is updated to latest commit (cc1118cd)
Rebuild container image: docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.devbob-local -t devbob:latest .
Redeploy StatefulSet: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/devbob -n metabob
Wait for pods to be ready: kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod/devbob-0 --timeout=120s
Verify both specifications: run validation harnesses for both

blockers: gh CLI not installed in running containers (image not rebuilt)

Dockerfile.devbob-local.coordinationNote: Must rebuild image with both OpenCode updates AND gh CLI

codeChanges.reasoning: All changes are additive and backward-compatible. Input validation, retry logic, timeouts, and cleanup are defensive programming patterns.

deployment.reasoning: Requires coordinated container rebuild and StatefulSet rollout. Two specifications depend on same deployment. Risk of one working and one failing if deployment is partial.

runtime.reasoning: Changes improve reliability (retry, timeout) and security (SQL injection prevention). No known runtime conflicts.

recommendations.action: Rebuild devbob container image with all changes
recommendations.rationale: Two specifications (devbob-acp-multi-vessel-coordination and devbob-k8s-git-operations) both require container updates. Coordinate single deployment to satisfy both.
steps: Rollout: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/devbob -n metabob

recommendations.action: Document deployment dependencies in specification metadata
recommendations.rationale: Future specifications should declare deployment dependencies to detect conflicts early
steps: List required container images, K8s resources, external services
Use in conflict detection to identify overlapping deployments

recommendations.rationale: Verify that multiple specifications work together after deployment
steps: Test ACP delegation (spec 1) and git operations (spec 2) in same container
Verify no resource contention or configuration conflicts

conclusion.caveat: Both devbob-acp-multi-vessel-coordination and devbob-k8s-git-operations require container rebuild. Deploy both together.
